title: Service-Level Credit Schedule of the Insurer Program Agreements
content:
Service-level credits are amounts the network owes the insurer for missed scorecard targets under the Insurer Program Agreements. Three figures per tier govern them:

- **Credit per missed target** — the credit owed to the insurer for each scorecard target missed in a quarter (US dollars; 0.00 means none).
- **Quarterly cap** — the most service-level credit owed for one quarter (US dollars).
- **Settlement period** — the calendar days after the scorecard within which a credit is settled (a whole number).

| Agreement tier | Credit per missed target (USD) | Quarterly cap (USD) | Settlement period (calendar days after the scorecard) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Network Referral Agreement | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Select Direct Repair Agreement | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | 500.00 | 1500.00 | 30 |
| Premier Direct Repair Agreement | 1000.00 | 3000.00 | 30 |
| Managed Repair Program Agreement | 2500.00 | 7500.00 | 30 |
| Enterprise Master Services Agreement | 5000.00 | 15000.00 | 30 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The Network Referral Agreement and the Select Direct Repair Agreement carry a credit of 0.00 per missed target, which the term defines as none.
2. In each tier that carries a credit, the quarterly cap equals three credits: 1500.00 is three times 500.00, 3000.00 three times 1000.00, 7500.00 three times 2500.00 and 15000.00 three times 5000.00.
3. The settlement period is counted in calendar days after the scorecard and is 30 days in every tier that carries a credit.
